non_claims: This pin records an identity; it does not fetch, verify against, or prove anything about the live corca-ai/ceal remote.

Only `source.tree` is checked locally, against `HEAD:packages/ceal-protocol`. `source.commit` is a recorded observation that no local check can confirm; confirming it needs the owner checkout (`git rev-parse <commit>:packages/ceal-protocol`).
`agreed` means the proof and shipment identities converged when this pin was written. It is not evidence that any release was built, installed, or accepted against the locked archive.

`shipped.protocol_tree` is no longer only self-recorded. The signed gateway-protocol-handoff-v0.71.6 manifest and its Protocol provenance both declare protocol_tree 3ca6fe3a…, and gateway-protocol-handoff-lock.json carries that value, so a pin naming a subtree the archive does not is now visible in this repository rather than only in the owner checkout.

The vendored copy at this pin builds to a `dist/` byte-identical to the one inside the signed `corca-ai-ceal-protocol-0.71.6.tgz` (observed on narnia, 2026-08-01, Node 22.22.1 / TypeScript 5.9.3). That is a one-time maintainer observation, not a check any gate re-runs.

The archive this pin ships against is published under the Gateway protocol-handoff release origin that .github/workflows/ceal-release.yml downloads from, and was verified there against its Sigstore certificate. This pin does not prove that origin still answers, only which bytes a release must accept from it.
